 VisualRAG — Multimodal Engineering Document QA System : FastAPI, CLIP, FAISS, Gemini 1.5 Flash, HuggingFace,
pdf2image
◦ Architected a 100%-free multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend for querying complex engineering PDFs
containing diagrams, tables, and technical figures using natural language.
◦ Pipeline: PDF → page-tile images (pdf2image + poppler) → CLIP vision encoder (HuggingFace, local) → FAISS in-memory
vector index→ top-K semantic retrieval→ Gemini 1.5 Flash multimodal generation with grounded source-page attribution.
◦ Entire stack uses 100%-free APIs: CLIP and FAISS run locally at zero cost; Gemini free tier supports 15 req/min and 1,500
req/day, making the system production-viable without cloud spend.
◦ Exposed 4 modular FastAPI REST endpoints ( /upload, /query, /status, /index) with auto-generated OpenAPI docs;
designed stateless architecture to enable horizontal scaling via Docker containerization.
◦ Achieved accurate semantic search on complex engineering diagrams and specification tables; supports multi-document indexing
with metadata-backed source tracking per retrieved page.
 FinQA-30K — Multi-Domain Financial QA Dataset : Python, Gemini Flash Lite, LangChain, HuggingFace Datasets,
JSONL — Dataset on Hugging Face — Paper Under Review
◦ Designed and open-sourced a large-scale LLM-assisted data generation pipeline producing ∼30,000 high-quality QA pairs across
10 financial domains: banking, corporate finance, cryptocurrency, financial planning, insurance, investment, mutual funds,
personal finance, stock market, and taxation.
◦ End-to-end automated pipeline: PDF document ingestion → text extraction & cleaning → semantic chunking→ Gemini Flash
Lite QA synthesis→ multi-stage quality validation (confidence filtering, format checks) → JSON/JSONL export.
◦ Implemented multi-stage quality validation to filter low-confidence and malformed QA pairs, ensuring high-fidelity output
suitable for LLM fine-tuning and RAG evaluation benchmarks.
◦ Dataset published at huggingface.co/datasets/kiritps/FinQA-30K; accompanying research paper ( FinQA-30K: A Multi-Domain
QA Dataset for Financial Knowledge Covering Ten Domains Generated via LLM-Assisted Pipeline ) currently under peer review.
 Resume Shortlisting System — AI-Driven Candidate Ranking : Flask, HuggingFace Hub, FAISS, RAG, LLM Fine-Tuning,
REST API
◦ Built and deployed an AI-driven resume shortlisting system using a custom RAG pipeline; fine-tuned an LLM on
domain-specific recruitment data hosted on HuggingFace Hub for contextual JD-resume understanding.
◦ Implemented semantic search using document embeddings + FAISS-backed vector store for candidate-to-job-description
matching; integrated rule-based multi-criteria evaluation for accurate candidate ranking.
◦ Developed a Flask-based REST API enabling automated scoring, returning structured per-candidate JSON results; designed for
seamless plug-and-play integration into existing HR workflows.
 Non-Invasive Neonatal Jaundice Detection — Hybrid ML/DL Model : Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV, Scikit-learn, CNN,
Random Forest
◦ Developed a non-invasive clinical diagnostic system for early neonatal jaundice detection using skin-color image analysis,
eliminating the need for blood-based bilirubin testing.
◦ Built a multi-stage preprocessing pipeline: gray-world white balancing → Retinex enhancement→ YCbCr/HSV skin region
segmentation→ CNN-based feature extraction→ Random Forest classification.
◦ Applied ADASYN, SMOTE-ENN, and Borderline SMOTE oversampling to address class imbalance; used random forest feature
selection to identify the 10 most discriminative features per dataset variant.
◦ Achieved 99.81% accuracy and 100% ROC-AUC with perfect true-positive discrimination at zero false-positive rate; results
submitted for peer review and tied to published breast cancer research paper.
Publications & Research
 Breast Cancer Prediction — ecancermedicalscience(In Press, 2026): Enhancing breast cancer prediction using a
customised neural network with oversampling and feature selection on Mizo population germline datasets. Co-authored study
published in ecancermedicalscience (Open Access, UK Charity no. 1176307). Developed a tailored neural network on germline data
with ADASYN, SMOTE-ENN, and Borderline SMOTE oversampling; random forest feature selection on 10 most important
features. Achieved 98% accuracy, 99% precision, 97% recall, 98% F1-score on balanced datasets; 100% ROC-AUC (ADASYN and
SMOTE-ENN). Received: 05/02/2026.
 Neonatal Jaundice Detection (Under Review) : Hybrid ML/DL model for non-invasive neonatal jaundice detection using
clinical image data. Multi-stage preprocessing with ADASYN, SMOTE-ENN, and Borderline SMOTE oversampling; CNN feature
extraction + Random Forest. Reviewer 3 comments addressed and manuscript resubmitted.
 FinQA-30K Dataset Paper (Under Review) : FinQA-30K: A Multi-Domain Question-Answer Dataset for Financial
Knowledge Covering Ten Domains Generated via Large Language Model-Assisted Pipeline. 30,000 high-quality financial QA pairs
across 10 domains. Dataset live at Hugging Face.

 Competitive Programming: LeetCode — 470+ problems solved | Skillrack — 900+ problems solved
